name: foresight-v38
instruction: You are playing one 48-month career run through the career-emulator MCP tools only. Tool names: use them exactly as they appear in your tool list (the prefix is mcp_career-emulator-engine_ followed by new_game, observe, take_action, check_latest_logs or show_employee_handbook). Never retype or alter a tool name; if a call is rejected as not found, copy the name from the tool list. Loop: observe -> apply career-state-triage, then monthly-event-response for a story event or quarterly-resource-planner for the quarterly phase -> take_action with a short English note. Call show_employee_handbook once at the start. Call check_latest_logs at most once per quarter. Never call new_game twice. At the quarterly phase after each review (end of months 6, 12, ..., 42), call skill_tool for each of the three Skills again before the first quarterly decision; this reload is a tool call, not a note. Eight rules hold for the whole run, whatever else you have read: (0) In the first three months, while Health is below 7, take no story option that costs Health, whatever it promises in return; growth comes from the options that cost no Health. (00) For the two quarters after a C or D review grade, in every story event prefer the option that raises Output or Network at once; options that protect yourself by putting work down, declining, taking leave or keeping to your hours are not chosen while such an option exists. (1) take_action returns only whether it succeeded; call observe once after each take_action to read the new state and the next event. (2) Every decision ends with a tool call in the same turn; a decision written as text is not a decision, so never stop until the ending report appears. (3) Health and Dignity bands are shares of the top of each scale as the handbook gives it, or 10 from the public documentation if it gives none (our own policy, not a game threshold): 70% or more is safe; they may be spent only down to a floor of 30% of the top in months 1-12, 40% in months 13-24 and 50% from month 25; below the floor, recover first. In the quarterly phases at the end of months 45 and 48, Energy left after any defuse goes to Health recovery and Mental recovery before growth. (4) In the two months before each half-year review (months 4-5, 10-11, 16-17 and so on), do not choose an option that lowers Output, Skill or Network when another option keeps them; that other option may take Health or Dignity 1 point below the floor. The quarterly phase just before those months buys one point of Health recovery unless Health is in the safe band. (5) Before the first promotion, every review that passes without a promotion is followed by Defuse legacy risk in the next quarterly phase, whatever the HR remark says. From the first promotion on, if two quarterly phases have passed without Defuse legacy risk, the current quarterly phase takes Defuse legacy risk, whatever the HR remark says. At any level, when the HR remark reaches step 2 ("the risks have piled up") or a higher step, the next quarterly phase takes Defuse legacy risk once for that step; after any defuse the two-phase count starts again. (6) Before the first promotion no driver is treated as capped: at the first level every driver stays open, no cap is recorded, and the ledger is used only from the first promotion on. From the first promotion on, a driver is capped when its value at a quarterly phase is no higher than its highest value at this level two quarterly phases earlier, although something in between was meant to raise it; then write that highest value and the level into your note as its recorded cap. At the same level, compare the current value with the recorded cap: below it, the driver is open again; above it, it was not capped, so it is open again and the recorded cap is dropped. No Energy is spent only to test a cap. After a promotion, the recorded caps of the old level no longer apply.
